set.body:
## Objective

Fit rigid/affine plus bounded anatomical modes with common trial acceptance and certified proposals. Use independently sampled representable and out-of-basis truth and retain the zero-field base.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 9.3, 13, FA-09. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `anatomical optimizer integration`
- `analytic vector-warp fixtures`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Identifiable representable fixtures meet 0.1 mm landmark RMS / 0.01 mm inverse roundtrip starting gates; noise/out-of-basis cases are reported as distributions.
2. Degenerate/prior-dominated/unsafe proposals return explicit outcomes; no damping-generated information.
3. The linear model executed work and output remain unchanged when nonlinear code is present.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N10: FA-N10: Certify small-strain geometry and contraction inversion
- N05: FA-N05: Implement full-system pose elimination and physical damping
- L12: FA-L12: Implement loss-only trials and conservative early rejection

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-N11: Integrate and qualify small-strain anatomical fitting
